notes.title: Lost Magic Is Here - Full Release Now on Steam!
notes.content:
It’s happened! Lost Magic is now on Steam and out of Early Access! ✨

🔮 Immerse yourself in a world that has lost its magic - a land full of ancient secrets and mysteries. Exciting adventures, unique spells, and dangerous enemies await you. Explore, fight, and uncover secrets that no one has yet conquered. Be the one to restore lost magic to this world. The world needs its heroes - start your adventure now!

Since Early Access, we’ve worked together to fix bugs, add new features, and prepare the game for release. Thanks to you - Lost Magic is now officially launched!

[b]What’s new:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Dungeon System: [/b]The Crypt can now be completed solo, with the option to choose power-ups after each boss. A group mode with higher difficulty and better rewards will be added later. Both modes will gradually expand to other dungeons too.
[*] [b]New Crypt Boss:[/b] Following your feedback, a new boss has appeared in the Crypt, and Silence will return later as an optional fight.
[*] [b]New Skills and Talents:[/b] The starting skills and the first two talent tiers for each Path have been completely reworked.
[*] [b]Updated Start:[/b] Improved tutorial, starting quests, and rewards.
[*] [b]Mod Updates:[/b] A free daily quest and increased drop rates for valuable mods. Mods now bind items to your character, and a mod trading system is coming soon.
[*] [b]Library and Bestiary: [/b]All discovered notes are now stored in the library, and the bestiary reveals detailed info about enemies.
[*] Plus many other improvements, fixes, and balance tweaks.
[/list]Thank you for joining us during beta and staying with us! Your support makes Lost Magic better - and we’ll keep growing together!

notes.title: Unlock the world of Lost Magic: Twitch Drops and DLC await you!
notes.content:
Get ready for new adventures - Lost Magic is finally leaving Early Access! A world full of challenges, unexpected encounters, and thrilling journeys awaits you.

[b]To celebrate this milestone, we’ve prepared special gifts:[/b]
📅 From July 17 to July 31, watch Lost Magic streams on Twitch for [b]at least one hour[/b] and receive unique Twitch Drops.
🎒 Every player can also claim the free Adventurer’s Starter Kit DLC to kick off their journey with reliable gear and useful bonuses.

Tune in, watch for an hour, grab your rewards - and set out on your next big adventure!

🔗 Join our official Discord and stay up to date: https://discord.gg/H9FBjdDw

notes.title: Release of Lost Magic!
notes.content:
🎉 Dear players!
Since the launch of Early Access, we’ve been closely monitoring the game, fixing bugs 🐛, and analyzing your feedback 🗣️. Thanks to this collaboration with the community, we’ve not only addressed many issues and introduced new mechanics ⚙️, but also outlined a clear path for the game’s future development 🗺️.

And now, we're excited to announce that the full release is coming on July 17! 🥳

🔑 Key changes:
[list]
[*] New dungeon system. The Crypt can now be completed alone, choosing buffs after each boss. Group mode will appear later with increased difficulty and rewards 🎁. Both modes will be gradually introduced for other dungeons 🏰.
[*] New boss in the Crypt. Following the wishes of the players, a new boss has appeared in the Crypt, and Silence will return later and will be optional 📣.
[*] New abilities and talents. A complete rework of the starting abilities and the first two tiers of talents for each Path 🌟.
[*] Updated start. The tutorial, starting tasks and rewards  have been reworked 🚀.
[*] Mod update. Free daily quest and increased chance of valuable mods dropping. Mods now make items personal, and mod exchange will be added soon 🎯.
[*] Library and bestiary. All found notes are now stored in the library, and the bestiary will reveal details about enemies 🐉.
[*] And many other improvements, fixes and balance adjustments ⚖️.
[/list]
Thank you for actively participating in beta testing and for staying with us. Your support makes the game better – and we continue to move forward with you! 🚀

notes.title: Major changes in gameplay - solo and group dungeon modes.
notes.content: [p][b]Major changes in gameplay - solo and group dungeon modes. [/b]🏰 [/p][p]The update introduced a number of important changes: updated start, reworked tutorial, expanded dungeon system, introduction of Solo mode, mod update, library, bestiary and much more![/p][p][/p][p][b]⚔️ Crypt is now solo![/b][/p][list][*][p]Solo mode is now available in the Crypt. Kill bosses - and choose buffs within the current copy.[/p][/*][*][p]A separate dungeon window has been added, with all the necessary information and functionality. [/p][/*][*][p]Group mode will become available later and will be a more difficult version with better rewards. [/p][/*][*][p]Similar modes are planned for other dungeons.   [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]👹[/b]  [b]New Crypt boss[/b][/p][p]Following the wishes of the players, a new boss has appeared in the Crypt, and Silence will return later and will become optional.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]✨[/b]  [b]New starting abilities and talents[/b][/p][p]All starting abilities, as well as the first two tiers of talents, have been reworked for each Path. [/p][p]The changes are aimed at improving balance and increasing dynamism at the initial levels. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]🛠️[/b]  [b]Mod Update[/b][/p][p]Listening to players’ feedback, we have revised the methods of obtaining mods:  [/p][list][*][p]York now has a free daily quest that can be completed to earn a box of common mods.  [/p][/*][*][p]Mimicry and unusual mods are now less likely to appear in boxes in favor of rare and epic ones.  [/p][/*][*][p]Mods now make equipment personal. Later it will be possible to exchange unnecessary mods for more valuable ones.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]📚[/b]  [b]Library and Bestiary[/b][/p][p]Now all collection notes can be read in the library, and the bestiary will open information about monsters: their abilities, drops and features.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]🚀[/b]  [b]Expanded Start[/b][/p][p]We have reworked the training design, training quests and updated the rewards in the initial tasks to make the start smoother and more intense.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]📝[/b] [b]Minor Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]A daily chest icon has appeared on the main screen.  [/p][/*][*][p]A simple mod box can now drop from the daily chest.  [/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to English translation, improved clarity and consistency across starting locations, talents, and abilities. [/p][/*][*][p]Transition times between locations have been reduced in places where they were 30 seconds.  [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the opening time of pop-up windows.  [/p][/*][*][p]Healing by 0 is no longer displayed in combat.  [/p][/*][*][p]A settings button has been added to the group list with a choice of loot distribution and the ability to leave the group.  [/p][/*][*][p]Medallion of the Warrior of Light now has a number of characteristics and does not require a magic shard to use.  [/p][/*][*][p]Buffs from Crypt bosses can now be removed.  [/p][/*][*][p]Nigel's ability now deals 50% rage damage instead of 70%.  [/p][/*][*][p]Lookatlogs now deal less damage.  And many other changes.  [/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned for more content coming! 🚧[/p]

notes.title: Update: New Maps, Interface Improvements, and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
It's time for fresh content and long-awaited improvements! The new build brings both visual updates and meaningful changes to the interface and gameplay behavior.

🔥 What's New:
[olist]
[*] Cloaks are now visible
[*] New Desert Map
[*] New Twilight City Map
[*] The map now opens in the tab that matches your current region (when possible)
[*] Simple tooltips when hovering over stats, objects, guilds, and more — fast and convenient
[/olist]
🧭 Interface Improvements:
[olist]
[*] We’ve reworked the tooltip behavior to make it more intuitive and consistent:
[*] Tooltips now appear on hover, not on click
[*] Clicking now hides the tooltip if it’s open
[*] Tooltips no longer conflict with each other (especially during loot distribution in groups)
[/olist]
✨ Minor but Pleasant Changes:
[olist]
[*] Added three rabbit pets
[*] Updated weapon icons and twilight area visuals
[*] Improved hairstyles
[*] New behavior when clicking on the character panel:
[/olist][list]
[*] Click on avatar — opens character window
[*] Click on name — opens party management menu
[/list]
🛠 Bug Fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed bugs related to image loading
[*] Fixed issue where boots appeared over pants
[*] Fixed issue where bracers appeared over sleeves
[*] Fixed hairstyles under helmets
[*] Fixed request handling issues
[*] Fixed problem with selling without confirmation
[*] Fixed message color display in the "Report Message" window
[*] Fixed server connection behavior — the "infinite authorization" issue should now occur less often (or be gone entirely)
[*] Fixed loot distribution window behavior when inventory was full
[*] And various other small fixes for subtle and tricky issues
[/olist]
See you in game!
Jump in on April 18 at 20:00 UTC — let's explore the new together!

notes.title: Adaptive Dungeon "Cat Show" is coming soon!
notes.content:
On April 18 at 20:00 UTC, a special dungeon "Cat Show" opens, available to all characters of level 5 and above! The difficulty adjusts to your level, each step is harder than the previous one, and at the end there will be a store with valuable and unique goods. 

[b]Main features:[/b] 
[olist]
[*] Endless corridors. With each circle, the dungeon is updated, the character is given the opportunity to strengthen himself 💪 or weaken enemies 👹, and upon death, the progress is reset.
[*] No copies of the dungeon. You can visit the show as many times as you like, but you need tickets for this 🎟️. You can get them from Victor for completing the daily task. You can also buy a bundle or buy tickets individually for labbits.
[*] Solo passage. The show is designed to be completed by one player, which makes it stand out from other dungeons.
[/olist]
[b]Two new currencies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cat food.🐱 Drops from monsters and cannot be taken outside the show.
[*] Cat toy.🧸 Dropped by bosses and considered more valuable than cat food. Remains even after exiting the dungeon.
[/list]
The show is located in the Courtyard of the castle. Get a free ticket from Victor and take a step towards new challenges! 🎉

notes.title: Twilight City - a new chapter of adventures!
notes.content:
Twilight City - a new chapter of adventures! 

Twilight City opens on April 7 at 20:00 UTC. At this time, technical work is expected for 1 hour. You will be one of the first to open the portal and set foot on new lands. Characters who have completed a chain of quests from Father Kitano can get into the new chapter. 🔮

Devastated by the cataclysm, Twilight City has become a haven for monsters. Among its ruins, terrifying bosses are hidden, ready to challenge even the most experienced heroes, and every step under the dome is exhausting, draining strength and depriving determination. 💀

But even in devastated lands there is room for wars and battles. The conflict between the Brotherhood and the Order flares up with renewed vigor in the fight for Energy Sources, opening up new possibilities for character development.⚔️

Will you be able to withstand all the horrors of Twilight City? Will you be the one to lead your faction to greatness? Or will you fade into obscurity like so many before you?

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements

Enjoy the update and stay tuned for more! 🔥

notes.title: Twilight Valley Awaits– Face the Unknown!
notes.content:
🌟 Greetings, adventurers!

New challenges are looming on the horizon, carefully concealed within the world of Lost Magic! Starting February 20, the Twilight Valley will open its gates to all characters of level 16 and above! This is a mysterious place where reality intertwines with dreams, and ancient forces awaken from centuries of oblivion.

🏯 The Sakura Clan has ruled the valley since time immemorial, but now their master weaponsmith, Hattori, seeks your help. You must win his trust and gain access to the Pagoda, the entrance to which is closed... Only prayers echo within — the clan awaits the return of Hoji, Hattori’s son. Until then, no one may enter or leave without the Clan Leader’s approval.

⚔️ Unravel the mystery of Hoji and determine the fate of the Pagoda! But beware—formidable bosses lurk in the shadows, ready to challenge only the strongest warriors. Those who prevail will claim powerful, unique equipment worthy of legends.

💭 Can you distinguish reality from a dream?
🔎 Will you be able to find Hattori's son?
🔥 Will you be ready to face the horrors of the Twilight Valley??

It all depends on you!

notes.title: 🔮 LostMagic Update: Improvements, Fixes & Exciting New Features!
notes.content:
The update is here, bringing a big journal overhaul, global chat, and important fixes!

⚒️ What’s new?

Massive journal redesign:
- The main journal, quest page, pet page, and abilities page all got a fresh look.
- You can now unlock a sixth ability slot!
- Global chat is live! Stay connected with players everywhere.
- Friends & enemies lists in settings have been updated for better usability.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements:

- No more disappearing messages in chat!
- Fixed AFK loot window endlessly opening (mushrooms, transistors, books, etc.).
- Fixed marking in settings and localization issues.
- Fixed pump behavior in the desert.
- Fixed pump updates after capture.
- Fixed errors with incorrect behavior of the game when the battle is not finished.
- Fixed the title text when the transaction completion error occurs when buying bundles.

✨ What’s next?

We’re already working on the next update with even more improvements! Keep the feedback coming - it truly helps us make the game better!

notes.title: THE GAME IS OUT!
notes.content:
THE GAME IS OUT NOW!

It’s finally here – LostMagic is live on Steam! 🎉 We’re incredibly excited to see so many of you joining the adventure. Before launch, we gathered an amazing 16,000 wishlists, and after the first weekend, we’ve already surpassed 22,000 lifetime total units sold! What an incredible journey so far, and it’s only the beginning!

🌍 Welcome to the world of LostMagic!
Get ready to explore a post-magic world, engage in strategic turn-based combat, and dive deep into the mysteries of a shattered realm. With challenging gameplay, beautiful pixel art, orchestral music, crafting, and intense PvP, we’re so excited to bring this adventure to you!

🚀 What’s Next?
We’re just getting started! More content, exciting events, and fun surprises are on the way. We’re actively working on bug fixes and gameplay improvements based on your feedback to make the game even better. Your support and suggestions are invaluable – we’re listening and shaping the future of LostMagic together! 💬

📌 Join the Discussion & Check Out Our Roadmap
We have big plans, and we’d love your input. Drop your ideas in the discussion boards and help us make LostMagic the best it can be. Your feedback helps us create new features, balance updates, and fresh content for everyone!

⭐ Leave a Review!
If you’re enjoying the game, leaving a review helps us immensely! It allows us to grow, improve, and add even more content for you to enjoy.

Thank you for being part of this journey! See you in LostMagic! 🔮✨
